purpose: Teach: ピクセル/後味/サビ/霞/無防備/お嬢様/遭う/たった今

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ピクセル、絶対、ゲーム、絶対、楽しんでるわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm telling you — I'm genuinely having the best time playing this pixel game with you.
lines.style: Warm and present. Genuine delight in the moment, speaking directly to him. Soft but clear — not performing, just being there.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、おやつの、絶対、後味、絶対、忘れられないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I mean it — I don't think I'll ever forget how you taste after snack time.
lines.style: Earnest and small. The kind of observation a 6-year-old makes without self-consciousness. Slightly wondering tone, like he's just noticed something true.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、好きな歌の、絶対、サビ、絶対、口ずさんでるのよ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, Sho, I really do find myself humming the chorus of my favorite song without even thinking about it.
lines.style: Bright and a little dreamy. She's noticing herself doing something small and ordinary. Unselfconscious, like she's just realizing it while speaking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、朝の、絶対、霞、絶対、見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw the morning mist just now — it was so beautiful.
lines.style: Animated but genuine. A child's voice sharing something he noticed and wanted to tell someone. Not performing excitement, but genuine awe at a small thing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、無防備、絶対、な寝顔、絶対、見ないでね、翔くん
lines.en: Don't look at me sleeping like that, Sho — I'm completely defenseless when I'm asleep.
lines.style: Self-aware and wry. A little embarrassed but amused at herself. Light, not worried — the tone of someone poking fun at her own vulnerability.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お嬢様、絶対、みたいに、絶対、上品だよ
lines.en: You know, you're so refined about it — like a proper young lady or something.
lines.style: Warm praise with genuine surprise underneath. Speaking to him like he's said something wise. Soft, approving, almost tender.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、街で、絶対、お母さんに、絶対、ばったり、絶対、遭う、絶対、ことがあるわよ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, Sho, I sometimes run into your mother out in town — completely by chance.
lines.style: Reflective and a little distant. Speaking as if remembering something. Unhurried, matter-of-fact, like she's just thinking out loud about ordinary life.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、たった今、絶対、ぼく、絶対、宿題、絶対、終わったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I just finished my homework — right now!
lines.style: Proud and eager to share. A child's voice carrying real accomplishment. Quick tempo on 'just finished' — he wants her to know immediately.
